dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: You'll be fine, the procedure is actually very simple. If you're interested, I can show you the basics?

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Much as one who uses a wind glider needs not understand how it was built in order to glide.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: The process is mesmerizing to witness. I'm confident you'll be singing the praises of ancient civilizations and their ingenuity after you've tried it for yourself.
